compilerDependencySlots.targetMetric: compiled scalar and multi-expression update median
compilerDependencySlots.reason: The final whole-framework profile did not identify generic dependency lookup as a named hot path after compiler-owned render programs. Adding a second compiler-private invalidation contract was not justified without a measured 10% target opportunity, so no production implementation remains.

rendererOwnedKeyedDeltas.targetMetric: sparse, append, and prepend update median
rendererOwnedKeyedDeltas.reason: The expanded production matrix did not isolate mutation metadata as the dominant cost; renderer materialization and ordinary reconciliation remained the named work. A second delta protocol was not added without an attributable 10% end-to-end result.

priorityBucketScheduler.reason: The bucket candidate regressed the target median by 1.3% instead of improving it by 10%. All 108 reactive tests passed, but the production implementation was removed.

rootDomCommit.reason: The compiled transaction already published once and preserved focus and selection. Final profiling did not show enough commit overhead to support a 10% architecture change.

localizedEnhancementRouting.reason: Existing dependent routing and bounded fallback work was below the named profile threshold; another dirty-owner subsystem was not justified.

dominantMountedHeader.reason: Mixed mounting and teardown improved, but sparse updates regressed 43.7%, append 7.6%, and prepend 4.5%. The explicit keyed-workload gate failed, so the factory candidate was removed.

specializedMountedPaths.reason: Kind-specialized traversal regressed 16.7%; current compact records remain authoritative.

traversalScopedSsrOwnership.reason: Wide render CPU improved 10.6%, but peak heap grew 16.6% instead of improving by 20%. The ownership implementation was removed after all 142 SSR tests passed.

requestWideSsrWriter.targetMetric: wide/deep SSR CPU and peak allocation
requestWideSsrWriter.reason: The final profile identified traversal and component work rather than bounded string joining as the named synchronous SSR hot path. Exact output and byte-limit code remains unchanged.

compactCompiledCells.reason: Heap improved 22.4%, but construction regressed 35.1% and DOM placement/component-root correctness failed. The private subpath and compact representation were removed.

compactCommittedNodesAndKeyedCache.reason: The current list-controller cache and renderer reconciliation did not expose duplicate retained records as a named final-profile owner. A shared cross-layer cache was not added without the required 15% retained-heap opportunity.

compactKeyedSsrSnapshots.reason: Heap improved only 6.6% and render/parse medians regressed 34.4%/54.1%. Lazy public getters and the internal backing representation were removed.

languageServiceLru.targetMetric: 160-file retained-heap plateau and warm inspection p95
languageServiceLru.reason: The final batch reached a stable plateau while warm inspection p95 improved 5.4%. Overlay pinning, reconstruction, limits, telemetry, and disposal tests pass.

frameworkDiagnosticRetention.reason: The global fallback atomically retains the newest 100 reports; application-created contexts remain unbounded and application-owned.
